repository.name: AbletonOSC
repository.description: Control Ableton Live via Open Sound Control (OSC)

architecture.registration_pattern: methods + properties_r + properties_rw lists in init_api(); framework auto-registers /live/<class>/get|set|start_listen|stop_listen/<prop>
architecture.listener_convention: Live API: add_<prop>_listener / remove_<prop>_listener — fully generic

preconditions: Live started with blank default set
Preferences > Record, Warp & Launch > Count-In = None

maintainer_preferences.philosophy: Lean codebase, no surplus files, reuse existing namespaces
maintainer_preferences.warns_about: AI-generated content is hard to review
maintainer_preferences.tests_required: for new logic/methods; encouraged but not blocking for property-list additions

stall_causes: Multiple competing implementations (5 Browser API PRs open)
New top-level namespaces when existing one fits (PR #153)
merge_recipe: Append to properties_r/rw lists when adding endpoints
Strip AI-generated commentary, devel notes, extra markdown

merged.title: Introduce missing Clip properties to run-console.py + view.py
Minor copy tweaks to code comments

closed.title: Add clip property handlers + README docs (leftovers)
closed.reason: duplicate of merged #143, opened from stale fork master
